answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Reaching the pulse of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. A ivory of per-task receipts records who did what, and the velvet of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
